---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL PT == INSTANCE TLAPS

\* Control invariant: fingerprint ownership and the single eviction frame.
OAEvictPC == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
OAPCs == OAEvictPC \cup {"pick", "put", "waitEv", "endWEv",
               "chkSnc", "cntns", "onSnc", "insrt", "isMth", "cas",
               "tryEv", "waitIns", "endEv", "Done"}
OAFrame(a,b,c) == [procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv",
                   ei |-> a, ej |-> b, lo |-> c]
OAControlType ==
  /\ pc \in [Writer -> OAPCs]
  /\ fp \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
  /\ stack = [s \in Writer |-> stack[s]]
OAHistory == history \subseteq fps
OAActiveFP == \A s \in Writer:
                 pc[s] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[s] \in fps
OAStackInv == \A s \in Writer:
       IF pc[s] \in OAEvictPC
             THEN \E a,b,c: stack[s] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
             ELSE stack[s] = <<>>
OAControl == OAControlType /\ OAHistory /\ OAActiveFP /\ OAStackInv
             /\ CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OAControlInit == Init => OAControl
BY PT!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, OAControl, OAControlType, OAHistory, OAActiveFP,
                    OAStackInv, OAPCs, OAEvictPC, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet

LEMMA OAControlStep ==
  OAControl /\ [Next]_vars => OAControl'
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME OAControl, Next PROVE OAControl'
  BY PT!SMTT("r5") DEF vars, OAControl, OAControlType, OAHistory,
     OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety
<1>2. ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, pick(s)
       PROVE OAControl'
  <2>1. OAControlType'
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OAControl, OAControlType,
      OAHistory, OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet,
      OAPCs, OAEvictPC
  <2>2. OAHistory'
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OAControl, OAControlType,
      OAHistory, OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet,
      OAPCs, OAEvictPC
  <2>3. OAActiveFP'
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OAControl, OAControlType,
      OAHistory, OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet,
      OAPCs, OAEvictPC
  <2>4. OAStackInv'
    BY <1>1, <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OAControl, OAControlType,
      OAHistory, OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet,
      OAPCs, OAEvictPC
  <2>5. CompleteAsSafety'
    <3>1. (fps \ history) = {} => history = fps
      BY <1>1, <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAControl, OAHistory

      OAPCs, OAEvictPC

<1>3. ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, cas(s)
       PROVE OAControl'

  <2>4. OAStackInv'
    <3>1. /\ stack[s] = <<>> /\ stack'[s] = <<OAFrame(ei[s],ej[s],lo[s])>>

  <2>5. CompleteAsSafety'

  <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5 DEF OAControl

       PROVE OAControl'

  <2>3. OAActiveFP'

      OAHistory, OAActiveFP, OAStackInv, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet,

  <2>4. OAStackInv'
    <3>1. /\ pc'[s] = "endEv" /\ stack'[s] = <<>>
      <4>1. PICK a,b,c: stack[s] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
        BY <1>1, <1>5, PT!SMTT("r5")
           DEF rtrn, OAControl, OAStackInv, OAEvictPC
      <4>2. /\ Head(stack[s]).pc = "endEv"
            /\ Tail(stack[s]) = <<>>
        BY <4>1, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAFrame
      <4>3. s \in DOMAIN stack /\ s \in DOMAIN pc

      <4>4. QED BY <4>2, <4>3, <1>5, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF rtrn
    <3>2. QED BY <3>1, <1>1, <1>5, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF rtrn, OAControl, OAControlType,

LOCAL OASQ == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

OAOrder(s) == /\ s \in Seq(Int)
              /\ \A i,j \in 1..Len(s): i<j => s[i]<s[j]

LEMMA OASelectBasic ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW P(_)
  PROVE /\ SelectSeq(s,P) \in Seq(S)
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,P)): P(SelectSeq(s,P)[i])
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,P)):
              \E j \in 1..Len(s): SelectSeq(s,P)[i] = s[j]
<1>1. SelectSeq(s,P) \in Seq(S)
  BY PT!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,P)): P(SelectSeq(s,P)[i])
  BY PT!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. s \in Seq(OASQ!Range(s))
  BY OASQ!SeqOfRange
<1>4. SelectSeq(s,P) \in Seq(OASQ!Range(s))
  BY <1>3, PT!SMTT("r5")
<1>5. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,P)):
              \E j \in 1..Len(s): SelectSeq(s,P)[i] = s[j]
  BY <1>4, OASQ!ElementOfSeq, OASQ!RangeEquality, PT!SMTT("r5")
<1>6. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>5

LEMMA OAOrderAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW s, OAOrder(s), NEW e \in Int,
         \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] < e
  PROVE OAOrder(Append(s,e))
BY PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderPrefix ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, OAOrder(Append(s,e))
  PROVE /\ OAOrder(s)
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] < e
BY PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderConcat ==
  ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAOrder(s), OAOrder(t),
         \A i \in 1..Len(s): \A j \in 1..Len(t): s[i]<t[j]
  PROVE OAOrder(s \o t)
BY OASQ!ConcatProperties, OASQ!LenProperties,
   OASQ!LenProperties, PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderSelect ==
  ASSUME NEW s, OAOrder(s), NEW P(_)
  PROVE OAOrder(SelectSeq(s,P))

  BY PT!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrder
<1>2. ASSUME NEW t \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int,
             OAOrder(t) => OAOrder(SelectSeq(t,P)),
             OAOrder(Append(t,e))
      PROVE OAOrder(SelectSeq(Append(t,e),P))
  <2>1. OAOrder(t) /\ \A i \in 1..Len(t): t[i]<e
    BY <1>2, OAOrderPrefix
  <2>2. OAOrder(SelectSeq(t,P))
    BY <1>2, <2>1
  <2>3. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(t,P)): SelectSeq(t,P)[i]<e
    <3>1. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(t,P)):
               \E j \in 1..Len(t): SelectSeq(t,P)[i] = t[j]
      BY OASelectBasic
    <3>2. QED BY <2>1, <3>1, PT!SMTT("r5")

          IF P(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(t,P),e) ELSE SelectSeq(t,P)
    BY <1>2, PT!SMTT("r5")
